title: The Fizz Drink Challenge
description: The Fizz Drink Challenge — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go Collect 12 of Sissirat's Energy Drinks from the Mutants in Vergrim's Vexation and Return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: The Fizz Drink Challenge

Zone: Vergrim's Vexation (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go Collect 12 of Sissirat's Energy Drinks from the Mutants in Vergrim's Vexation and Return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

Hello there, Dungeon Runner. Business is good, thanks to you and all of you Dungeon Running fanatics, and I can barely keep my potions in stock. With all of this new income I have decided to branch out and create my own line of potions. There is only one hurdle in my plan, you see, I don't really know how to make new potions... I know, it's sad, here I am a kingdom renowned alchemist and I can't make a new potion recipe. I can turn me some lead into gold though, that I got down! Too bad we used up all the lead in the kingdom to make those ever-so-popular King's Coin.

Anyway, back to the point. I need you to go and collect some of the potions that the Whiskers in Vergrim's Vexation have been selling to the Mutants. I've heard wonderful things about the magic properties in those energy drinks and if I can get my hands on some I think I could extract the ingredients and start to make them myself. Go collect 12 of Sissirat's brand Energy Drinks and return to me, Audrey the Alchemist, here in Townston when you are done.

Turn-in:

Let me see them, let me see! Oh my! They look so.... cool! Whoever the head of their marketing division is they need a raise. They really know how to create a look for their brand, my word. Job well done, here is some gold for you then.

Objectives:

  • Sissirat's Fizz-All ×12

Level range: 20–30
